questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How toys help children learn at school
Why toys have become too expensive for parents
The growing number of adults who buy children's toys for themselves
How to make soft toys from leather
questions.why: They discuss the trend of 'kidults' – adults who buy kids' toys for themselves.

questions.q: What happened to the toys Phil had as a boy?
options: He gave them to his children
He sold them online
He still plays with them
He lost them all when he moved house
questions.why: Phil says he has a couple, but he gave them to his kids.

questions.q: What share of the toy market do adults buying toys for themselves make up?
options: Around 10%
Between 30 and 40%
More than half of it
About 15 to 20%
questions.why: Beth says estimates suggest they account for between 30 and 40% of the toy market.

questions.q: Which toys were among the most popular with American kidults?
options: Building bricks
Video games
Model cars, trains and planes
Soft toys made from cloth
questions.why: Phil says plush toys, or plushies, were among the most popular.

questions.q: When did toy maker Lisa Lee start buying soft toys again?
options: When her own children were born
During the Covid lockdowns
When she started making videos for her YouTube channel
Once she had a steady job and some spare money
questions.why: She says she rediscovered her love for soft toys once she had a stable job with disposable income.

questions.q: What do toys mean to Lisa Lee?
options: They are mainly a way to make money
They bring her joy and help her reconnect with her childhood
They remind her of a difficult time
They are useful in her job as a teacher of young children in Vancouver
questions.why: She says toys bring her happiness and are part of 'reconnecting with my childhood'.

questions.q: According to collector Jay Glatfelter, what happened to toy prices during the pandemic?
options: Prices on the second-hand market rose sharply
Prices fell because shops were closed
Prices stayed the same as before
New toys became cheaper than old collectable ones
questions.why: He says secondary market prices seemed to 'explode once the pandemic happened'.

questions.q: Why, according to Jay, did so many new collectors appear during the pandemic?
options: Toy companies gave away free samples
Children asked their parents to collect toys with them during the lockdowns
People had free time and money they weren't spending on going out
Influencers were paid to promote toys
questions.why: He says people had time on their hands and extra money because they weren't going out.
